title: Tech Note: Managing Menu Bars Across Forms and Processes
author: Bryan Yen, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Create menu / RELEASE MENU (menu bar references)
SET/GET MENU ITEM PARAMETER and PROPERTY

historical_commentary.text: Menu bar management via SET MENU BAR, Create menu references, and menu item parameters/properties remains 4D's current, unchanged mechanism for classic desktop application menus; nothing here has been deprecated, though this entire topic applies only to classic desktop 4D apps, not to web/ORDA-based UIs where menu bars are not the relevant UI paradigm.
related_updates: No successor feature has replaced classic menu bar commands (SET MENU BAR, Create menu, DISABLE/ENABLE MENU ITEM) for desktop 4D applications
The note's mention that Active Menu Bar form property is automatically enabled in Project mode forms reflects Project mode's now-default status; this remains true in current versions
